title: Sir Charles Thompson: plans to work together
summary: Humes is alive and in Zurich and plans to use Sir Charles Thompson at the Cookery. He is sometimes touchy with the band, she advises him to just go along, and she notes people must go to Europe to get big.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: A lot of the fellows I know when I see them.
Yeah, that's right. Well listen, what about Sir Charles (Thompson)?
Oh, Sir Charles Thompson?
Yeah.
I'm going to be using him a little later.

Now listen Helen, this is going to be very interesting to Ron Welburn at Rutgers because he said, could I tell him about his next of kin or something. And Stanley and I said, 'well, Sir Charles is all right, surely'.
He's alright because he called me.

Well Ron will be so pleased to know that because he sent -- see I did Sir Charles a long time ago for this same project out here in L. A. and Ron wanted to send him the transcript of it. And he sent to him -- and the letter came back saying 'unknown', an unopened letter, unknown or no next of kin or something. So Ron had thought that maybe something had happened to him. But he's here on the West Coast?
